review_candidates.title: AI Solutions Architect
review_candidates.description: Global supply chains are broken, wasteful, and increasingly fragile, and traditional tools are not built to adapt. At Mentana, we believe autonomous intelligence is the key to solving the world’s hardest supply chain bottlenecks. We are on a mission to transform global supply chains from human-centric to agent-led autonomous forecasting, planning, and execution with our Mentana Autonomous Supply Chain Manager . Our platform challenges the status quo, turning reactive logistics into proactive, highly resilient operations. As we scale, we are hiring two (2) x AI Solutions Architects to sit on the front lines with our enterprise clients. You will bridge the gap between our core autonomous technology and our clients' most complex supply chain challenges. If you are driven by solving mission-critical problems that directly impact the real-world economy, we’d love to talk. ‍ THE ROLE We are looking for an experienced AI Solutions Architect to translate real-world business problems into clear, implementable AI solutions with our Mentana Autonomous Supply Chain Manager. You will work across business, product, software and data teams to define what the solution must achieve, what the Mentana AI agents need to do, and what data and technology are required to make it work. The role is centred on creating a clear end-to-end line of sight from Business Problem → Business Outcome → Agent Responsibilities → Data Requirements → Technical Solution → Measurable Value. You will have a very high degree of autonomy in driving a successful relationship with our strategic clients and partners. ‍ ‍ WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE You eliminate ambiguity between the business need, the required capabilities of the agents, and the data foundation required to deliver it. A successful solution has a clear business outcome, a precisely and well defined agent, implementable tasks and workflows, fit-for-purpose data, and measurable value. ‍ KEY RESPONSIBILITIES You eliminate ambiguity between the business need, the required capabilities of the agents, and the data foundation required to deliver it. A successful solution has a clear business outcome, a precisely and well defined agent, implementable tasks and workflows, fit-for-purpose data, and measurable value. ‍ DEFINE THE BUSINESS REQUIREMENTS & VALUES Translate an ambiguous business problem or opportunity into a structured solution requirement; Understand the current state, pain points, processes, systems, users and constraints; define the desired future state, scope, success measures and expected business value; and Clearly articulate benefits such as productivity, cost reduction, growth, customer experience, quality, risk reduction and faster decision-making, together with technical value such as automation, integration, scalability, security, reliability and reusability. ‍ DEFINE THE AI AGENT DESCRIPTIONS, TASK & WORKFLOWS Turn business requirements into a precise definition of what the AI agent must do; Define its purpose, responsibilities, triggers, inputs, understanding, decisions, actions, tools, outputs and escalation paths; and Break complex work into executable tasks and sub-tasks, define business rules, constraints, exception handling and human-in-the-loop requirements, and establish measurable task-completion criteria. ‍ DEFINE DATA REQUIREMENTS & TRANSFORMATION Identify the data needed by the solution and where it resides across systems, applications, documents, APIs and databases; Define data mapping, quality, completeness, timeliness, context and access requirements, and work with Data Engineers to specify how source data must be extracted, cleaned, validated, standardised, enriched, transformed, structured, combined and made available to the AI agent; and Ensure security, privacy, governance and retention requirements are understood. ‍ ARCHITECT THE END-TO-END SOLUTION Translate the requirements into a practical AI solution architecture covering agents, models, data, APIs, integrations, workflows, applications and cloud services; Assess technical feasibility, risks, dependencies, security, scalability, reliability and maintainability; and Produce architecture and implementation-ready documentation that AI Engineers, Software Engineers and Data Engineers can act on without ambiguity. ‍ ABOUT YOU We are looking for an experienced AI Solutions Architect who commands deep technical expertise with a strong business acumen. You have a proven track record with deep technical hand-on experience as a Solution Architect, AI Architect, Business Architect, Product Architect, Software Architect or similar role. You can demonstrate at a deep level the following: Understanding of AI agents, Generative AI, LLMs, automation and AI-enabled business processes; Business analysis and requirements-definition skills with the ability to turn ambiguity into clear specifications and know how to balance business value, technical feasibility, security, scalability and delivery constraints; Ability to define detailed workflows, tasks, decision logic, exception handling and human-in-the-loop requirements; Understanding of data architecture, data flows, data transformation and data quality; Understanding of APIs, system integration, enterprise architecture and cloud-based solutions; Experience collaborating with Data Engineers, Software Engineers, AI Engineers, Product Managers and business stakeholders; and Excellent documentation, communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, including explaining complex technology to non-technical stakeholders. ‍ WHAT WE OFFER A competitive compensation package including opportunities for employee options awards (conditions applied) ; Opportunities to enjoy meaningful and disruptive works on game-changing products; A flexible, supportive and productive working environment; Passionate colleagues and friends. You can find some interesting and like-minded folks here; and A strong commitment to your personal and professional growth. You will be a better guru than you are today. And that is a promise! ‍ If you like what you read, please reach out to us at talents@mentana.ai with your CV and 2-5 sentences about why you are the best person for this role!

review_candidates.title: Observability - Site Reliability Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Peraton Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure. About The Role We are seeking Observability / Site Reliability Engineers to design, implement, and operate telemetry and reliability capabilities across enterprise infrastructure, platform services, applications, and workloads. The engineers will implement centralized metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerts, and reliability practices using OpenTelemetry or equivalent industry standards and approved enterprise tooling. This role combines observability engineering, site reliability practices, production operations, automation, and performance analysis to improve system health, availability, and operational resilience. Responsibilities Telemetry Engineering Implement standardized collection of metrics, logs, and distributed traces across enterprise environments. Establish OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation and telemetry collection patterns where appropriate. Integrate cloud, Kubernetes, platform, application, and infrastructure telemetry into centralized observability services. Maintain telemetry pipelines, retention, routing, and data-quality controls. Develop and maintain instrumentation and telemetry configurations to support effective system monitoring and troubleshooting. Reliability & Performance Engineering Develop dashboards, alerts, service-health views, and operational metrics to provide visibility into system performance and availability. Define and monitor Service Level Objectives (SLOs), availability indicators, latency, error rates, saturation, and capacity measures. Analyze system performance, capacity, utilization, and operational trends to identify potential reliability issues and corrective actions. Apply site reliability engineering practices to improve system availability, performance, scalability, and operational resilience. Identify opportunities to improve detection, response, and recovery across enterprise services. Operations & Automation Support incident diagnosis, cross-service troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis for complex reliability and observability issues. Automate recurring monitoring, alerting, reporting, and remediation activities where appropriate. Partner with operations and engineering teams to improve incident detection and response and reduce recurring issues. Participate in Tier 3/4 escalation and on-call support for observability, platform, and reliability issues. Develop and maintain operational procedures, troubleshooting documentation, and knowledge articles. Support continuous improvement of monitoring and reliability practices based on operational data and incident trends. Location: This position is fully onsite in Chantilly, VA Qualifications Required Qualifications Active TS/SCI clearance with CI Polygraph. Approximately 5-8 years of experience in observability, site reliability engineering, operations, platform engineering, cloud engineering, or a related technical discipline. 5 years experience with a BS/BA, an additional 4 years of experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. Hands-on experience with metrics, logging, tracing, monitoring, and alerting. Experience with Kubernetes and cloud environments. Strong troubleshooting, systems analysis, and performance-analysis skills. Experience operating and supporting production services and responding to technical incidents. Experience with scripting, automation, or infrastructure-as-code practices. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Desired Qualifications Experience with one or more of the following: OpenTelemetry. Prometheus and Grafana. CloudWatch, OpenSearch, or comparable cloud monitoring and observability platforms. Distributed tracing and application performance monitoring. SLO, SLA, and error-budget practices. Observability for large-scale or distributed enterprise platforms. Automated incident response or remediation. Observability within secure or highly regulated enterprise environment Details Target Salary Range: $112,000 - $179,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits. Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own. EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

review_candidates.title: Staatssekretär/in EDA
review_candidates.description: Bern, Schweiz | 100-100% | Diesen Beitrag können Sie leisten Das Staatssekretariat des EDA, einschliesslich des Aussennetzes, führen. Den Vorsteher des EDA bei der Führung des Departements unterstützen sowie ihn und den Bundesrat in allen Fragen der schweizerischen Aussenpolitik beraten. Die aussenpolitische Strategie des Bundesrates umsetzen und für die Kohärenz der schweizerischen Aussenpolitik sowie deren Abstimmung mit den anderen Departementen sorgen. Geopolitische Entwicklungen frühzeitig erkennen, deren Auswirkungen auf die Schweiz beurteilen und entsprechende Handlungsoptionen entwickeln. Für die Pflege der Kontakte zwischen den Schweizer Behörden und den Behörden anderer Staaten auf bilateraler Ebene sowie mit internationalen Organisationen auf multilateraler Ebene verantwortlich sein. Die Interessen und Positionen der Schweiz gegenüber ausländischen Regierungen und internationalen Organisationen vertreten. Den Vorsteher des EDA auf innenpolitischer Ebene, insbesondere gegenüber Parlament, Kantonen, Organisationen und dem internationalen Genf, unterstützen und vertreten. Die Zusammenarbeit und Koordination innerhalb des EDA sowie mit den anderen Departementen sicherstellen. Das macht Sie einzigartig Schweizer Diplomat/in mit langjähriger und breiter diplomatischer Erfahrung im In- und Ausland. Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung auf hoher strategischer Ebene und ausgewiesene Fähigkeit, grosse und komplexe Organisationseinheiten zu führen und Veränderungsprozesse zu gestalten. Fundierte Kenntnisse der schweizerischen Aussenpolitik, der internationalen Beziehungen sowie des politischen und institutionellen Systems der Schweiz. Ausgeprägtes strategisches und politisches Urteilsvermögen sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe geopolitische Entwicklungen zu analysieren und daraus klare Handlungsoptionen für die Schweiz abzuleiten. Ausgewiesene Verhandlungsfähigkeit, hohe interkulturelle Kompetenzen und Erfahrung in der Vertretung schweizerischer Interessen auf hoher internationaler Ebene. Entscheidungsstarke, integre und belastbare Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägten Führungs-, Kommunikations- und Sozialkompetenzen sowie sicherem politischem Gespür. Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzuführen, tragfähige Lösungen zu entwickeln und innerhalb und ausserhalb der Bundesverwaltung belastbare Netzwerke und Vetrauensbeziehungen aufzubauen und zu pflegen. Fähigkeit, den Vorsteher des EDA loyal und mit eigenständigem Urteil zu beraten und politische Vorgaben wirksam in die Führung und Arbeit des Departements zu übersetzen. Sehr gute Kenntnisse von mindestens zwei Amtssprachen sowie des Englischen; Kenntnisse einer weiteren Amtssprache sind von Vorteil. Auf den Punkt gebracht Das bieten wir Arbeiten für die Schweiz Wir setzen uns für das Erfolgsmodell Schweiz ein und arbeiten zum Wohl der Bevölkerung. Gelebte Vielfalt Dank Chancengleichheit entfalten wir unsere Kompetenzen und bringen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ein. Gesund am Arbeitsplatz Wir unterstützen und beraten unsere Mitarbeitenden im Bereich der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit. Alle Benefits Das Eidgenössische Departement für auswärtige Angelegenheiten (EDA) koordiniert und gestaltet im Auftrag des Bundesrats die Schweizer Aussenpolitik, wahrt die Interessen des Landes und fördert Schweizer Werte. Das Staatssekretariat (STS) steuert die Entwicklung, Koordination und Planung der Aussenpolitik und ist zuständig für die Berichterstattung zuhanden der politischen Behörden und die Leitung des Aussennetzes der Schweiz. Es verantwortet die Umsetzung der aussenpolitischen Strategie der Schweiz. Zu den wichtigsten Dossiers gehören die Zusammenarbeit mit den Vereinten Nationen (UNO), die Entwicklung der Beziehungen zur Europäischen Union (EU) sowie die Sicherheits- und Friedenspolitik. Zusätzliche Informationen Die Funktion erfordert eine hohe zeitliche Flexibilität. Der Bundesrat legt Wert auf eine vielfältige Zusammensetzung des obersten Kaders der Bundesverwaltung. Bewerbungen von Personen aller Geschlechter und Sprachregionen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht. Motivationsschreiben: Für diese Funktion ist ein Motivationsschreiben Pflicht. Assessment: Eine Empfehlung aus dem Assessment Center (AC) Topkader ist für diese Stelle Voraussetzung. Bewerbungsfrist: 25.10.2026 Für weitere Informationen bitte wenden Sie sich an: Alexandre Fasel, Staatssekretär EDA, +41 58 482 24 00 Fragen zur Stelle
